column1: # Source: Google Books Ngram Viewer corpus eng_2019 (en-2019
# Locator: Google Books Ngram Viewer JSON API
# Epistemic: measured (annual percentage of case-sensitive lowercase "artificial intelligence" among all 2-grams in Google Books English corpus eng_2019)
# Method: scripted (queried Google Books Ngram JSON endpoint for 1950-2019 unsmoothed 2-gram share and scaled by 100 to percent)
# Computation: pct_2grams = 100 * share_of_2grams from upstream JSON timeseries for years 1950..2019 (SHA-256: e62cf6d6531a236954de9a617c2a3841686f5f6e09ffaeac9620e662973693e1).
#   year: integer [year] — Publication calendar year in the Google Books eng_2019 corpus
#   pct_2grams: number [percent] — Annual percentage share of lowercase 2-gram 'artificial intelligence' among all English 2-grams

# Notes: Measures relative 2-gram frequency across English-language books in Google Books eng_2019 (not percent of U.S.-published book titles). @michel2011quantitative introduced the culturomics method on earlier corpora ending in 2008; values through 2019 come from the updated eng_2019 release.
